bench_apply_for_issue.description: Single apply_for_issue call: guards + auth + global-count read/write + app-entry write + TTL bumps + event

bench_assign_issue.description: Single assign_issue call given pre-existing application: guards + auth + app removal + assignment write + count updates + TTL bump + event

bench_complete_assignment.description: Single complete_assignment call given active assignment: guards + auth + assignment removal + count decrement + TTL bump + event
